description: Lets AI assistants read what NVDA reads, hear what it speaks, and, if you allow it, press keys, through the Model Context Protocol. Needs the free nvda-mcp server; see the add-on's help.

translations.description: Memungkinkan asisten AI membaca apa yang dibaca NVDA, mendengar apa yang diucapkannya, dan, jika Anda izinkan, menekan tombol, melalui Model Context Protocol. Membutuhkan server nvda-mcp yang gratis; lihat bantuan add-on.
